parameters.name: FieldSeparator
parameters.description: Field separator to use when encoding CSV data.

parameters.name: RowSeparator
parameters.description: Row separator to use when encoding CSV data.

parameters.name: EscapeCharacter
parameters.description: Escape character to use when encoding CSV data.

parameters.name: ReportFormat
parameters.description: This parameter describes the formatting used for reports defined by this profile as described in {{template|BULK-DATA-CSV-REF}}. Note: This parameter is encoded as a token in the BBF-Report-Format header field and MUST NOT include spaces or other characters excluded from token characters defined in {{bibref|RFC2616}}.

parameters.name: RowTimestamp
parameters.description: The format of the timestamp to use for data inserted into the row.

object.description: This object defines the properties to be used when the {{object|##.Profile}} object's {{param|#.EncodingType}} parameter value is {{enum|CSV|##.EncodingTypes}}.
